You are a strict natural-language-inference judge for UI element descriptions.
Given the on-screen context of a single widget and two descriptions A and B, decide whether A ENTAILS B: does A being true force B to be true, for THIS widget on THIS screen?
Answer with exactly one lowercase word on the first line: entailment, neutral, or contradiction. No other text.

Widget context:
  screen: N/A (calibration: Screen Annotation sample, out-of-domain screen)
  element_id: 4
  visible_text: Please update your network preferences for downloading content (including updates and subscriptions).
  role: 

A: Description Text - "Please update your network preferences for downloading content (including updates and subscriptions)."
B: Text - "Please update your network preferences for downloading content (including updates and subscriptions)."

Does A entail B? Answer: entailment | neutral | contradiction
